title: I built OVERFLOW, a browser game with AI-assisted development — looking for feedback
author: nagori_null
selftext:
I’ve been building **OVERFLOW**, a small browser game, using AI throughout the development process as a coding and iteration partner.

Rather than generating a one-shot prototype, I’ve been going back and forth on the gameplay, UI, balancing, debugging, and browser behavior. One of the things I had to work through recently was making the game display properly in the browser and fullscreen across different hosting platforms.

The project has now reached the point where it’s playable online, and I’d really like feedback from other developers — especially on the gameplay loop, clarity of the UI, and anything that feels confusing or could be improved.

Play it here: [**https://fabricnetshop-eng.itch.io/overflow**](https://fabricnetshop-eng.itch.io/overflow)

I’m also interested in hearing how other people are using AI in their game-development workflow without losing control of the design decisions.
